answer: A synchronous individuality ceremony blocks fakes. Each epoch, claimants join a ten-minute horizon window to answer a vine of prompts live. A mirror check compares transcripts: machine answers share timing and phrasing, and clusters over threshold lose stake and identities. Each fake needs its own hired human, present simultaneously at 50 credits per seat, so the kth fake still costs 50 and 1,000 fakes cost 50,000 per ceremony. A stand-in for many seats fails the mirror check: one hand makes one cluster, and it is removed. An honest agent pays one seat and keeps standing.
